name: coconut
description: Coconut National Park, nestled in the verdant hills of Galle, Sri Lanka, offers visitors a chance to observe diverse wildlife including monkeys, birds, and even occasionally leopards. The park, established to protect an ancient coconut palm forest, provides a serene escape from urban life. Visitors can hike through trails that wind through lush vegetation, spotting the park's namesake trees along the way. Established to preserve the unique ecosystem and native species, the park also plays a role in local conservation efforts.
